Context-only vs answer-only SAE features (issue #1482)

Enrichments are associations, not mechanisms. Every number below is an association between a judged label and a side class, measured on observational data. Nothing here says a feature does anything.

Descriptions are a reading aid, not evidence — and any KIND reading rests entirely on them. Descriptions and axis labels come from #1773, whose standing caveat is that they are search-index-only (neighbour discrimination 0.322 against a 0.50 bar). The enrichment table is measured; the impression that these features are recognisable kinds, formed from the card text below, is the least evidenced thing on this page.

"Never fires on side X" is a strong criterion. It means zero across all 120,000 fit rows at ROW-OCCUPANCY grain — the feature counts as active if it fires anywhere in the span. A feature firing at a single token of a single answer is NOT answer-only. Token counts come from the run-length capture, a 2,000-row subsample — a different, far smaller denominator than the 120,000-row census that defines the side classes. They describe depth on the live side and are NOT the evidence for one-sidedness.

STRUCTURAL GAP — #1773 does not cover context-only features at all. Axis-label coverage is 100% of two-sided and 100% of answer-only features, but 0 of 1,654 (0%) of context-only features. None of them has a description either.

Why, and why it is not fixable by re-running anything. #1773 built its activating-example windows from each feature's own answer-side activation (ans_max quantile bins) and dropped features with zero activating windows before dispatch. A context-only feature has zero by the very property that makes it context-only. Its exclusion set is exactly {context-only} ∪ {dead} — 2,560 features, set-equality verified.

Consequence for this page. The judged-label enrichment is computable for answer-only features only. For context-only the axes abstraction, content_type, functional_role, interpretable, speaker_property are reported as NOT COMPUTABLE rather than omitted, so an empty row is never mistaken for a null result. The Gurnee promoting class is derived from the decoder, not from autointerp, so it IS available for both groups — it is the only judged column that spans them. The cards below still carry every measured quantity for context-only features; only the interpretive text is missing.

So the question "do context-specific kinds exist?" cannot be answered from the current substrate, and the reason is not sampling noise. Answering it requires describing context-only features from CONTEXT-side activating windows — a labelling run that does not yet exist.

Populations. Of 130,166 live features, 1,654 are context-only (fire in the context, never in the answer) and 2,164 are answer-only — together 2.9% of live features. The remaining 126,348 two-sided features are the baseline to contrast against, not a population to enumerate. Answer-only features are the cleanest argument that the map must PRODUCE answer-space structure rather than copy context-space structure, which is why the question is what they are, not how many.

Why activity stratification is not optional. Median total row occupancy is 2 of 120,000 for both side-specific classes versus 1,283 for two-sided, so a crude enrichment would largely re-report activity composition. Both columns are shown; a level whose crude effect vanishes once matched is flagged dissolves into activity.

Unmatchable by construction. A two-sided feature needs at least one row on each side, so no two-sided feature can have occupancy 1. Occupancy-1 features (587 context-only, 725 answer-only) therefore have no baseline and are excluded from the standardized estimate. Matched coverage: context-only 64.5% (1,067/1,654), answer-only 66.5% (1,439/2,164).

Method. Direct standardization to the GROUP's occupancy distribution over fixed integer occupancy strata; exact conditional (hypergeometric) null; 20,000 draws; BH-FDR across all 31 tests. Stratifier: total row occupancy = fit rows active in the CONTEXT span + fit rows active in the ANSWER span, out of 120,000. This is the only activity measure defined for BOTH classes: the substrate's `activity` column is answer-side only and is identically 0 for every context-only feature.

Label coverage (#1773, of 131,072): {'abstraction': 128482, 'content_type': 128482, 'speaker_property': 128482, 'functional_role': 128482, 'interpretable': 128482}. Unlabelled features are excluded from that axis's denominator.

(b) Activity-standardized enrichment — the licensing evidence

Filled markers are activity-standardized, hollow are crude; the gap between them is the activity artefact. Green rows are BH-FDR q < 0.05.
